title.narrative: Pamoja kwa mabadiliko - Together for change

description.narrative: The project aims to enable and promote the participation of men, women and young people in local democratic governance, their involvement in the preservation of a healthy environment, particularly in the adoption of attitudes and behaviour conducive to good waste/improvement management and sanitation in the city, and their commitment to peaceful cohabitation and social cohesion. Obstacles exist that prevent them from participating or being effectively involved in the decision-making process. To overcome these obstacles, the project intends to implement a series of strategies: dialogues between officials and the citizens with civil society on local governance issues, in order to address youth and women's lack of participation in decision-making and the consolidation of peace and social cohesion; capacity-building and forums for exchange and awareness-raising on innovative ideas for managing rubbish and cleaning up the city to ensure a clean and protected environment. The project will be implemented by CDJP Uvira staff with support from CAFOD Governance and Peace building Program.
